label: MARRIAGE REPAIR

cover.headline: 4 signs it’s time for *a plan*, not just more trying
cover.sub: When effort alone isn’t moving things.

points.heading: You’ve tried, and you’re tired
points.body: You’ve had the talks and made the promises. Effort without a direction wears anyone down.
points.panel: Write down what you’ve already tried.

points.heading: You don’t know where to begin
points.body: Everything feels tangled together. A starting point matters more than a perfect answer.
points.panel: Pick the one thing that hurts most right now.

points.heading: Talks keep ending the same way
points.body: If every conversation lands in the same place, you may need a different way in.
points.panel: Notice the moment your talks usually turn.

points.heading: You want steps, not slogans
points.body: “Communicate more” is true and not very helpful. You want to know what to actually do on a Tuesday.
points.panel: “What would one small step look like this week?”

resource.name: Save The Marriage System
resource.covers: A structured starting point for communication and reconnection.

caption:
Trying harder works until it doesn’t. If you’ve been putting in the effort and things still feel stuck, the problem may not be effort. It may be the lack of a map.

If that sounds familiar, there’s a resource at the link in bio that offers a structured starting point for communication and reconnection. It can’t promise how anyone else will respond, and no program can. It can give you somewhere to begin.

Follow @spotseason for more small steps.
